query: SELECT npc_response_collection.id, npc_response_collection.root_sequence_id, npc_response_collection.group_id, npc_response_collection.state, npc_response_collection.scene_revision, "group".scene_revision AS current_revision FROM npc_response_collection JOIN "group" ON "group".id = npc_response_collection.group_id JOIN npc_discussion ON npc_discussion.root_sequence_id = npc_response_collection.root_sequence_id WHERE "group".world_id = ? AND "group".retired_at IS NULL AND npc_response_collection.group_id NOT IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?)) AND npc_response_collection.state IN ('collecting', 'selected') AND npc_discussion.state = 'ready'                AND (npc_response_collection.state = 'selected' OR NOT EXISTS (                    SELECT 1 FROM npc_response_collection AS earlier                    WHERE earlier.group_id = npc_response_collection.group_id                      AND earlier.state IN ('selected', 'executing'))) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM npc_response_source JOIN message ON message.id = npc_response_source.message_id LEFT JOIN inference ON inference.id = message.source_inference_id JOIN sequence ON sequence.id = COALESCE(message.trigger_sequence_id, inference.sequence_id) WHERE npc_response_source.collection_id = npc_response_collection.id AND (sequence.finished_at IS NULL OR sequence.error IS NOT NULL)) ORDER BY npc_response_collection.id LIMIT 1
